implementation.retrieval: deterministic catalog keyword matcher (prototype; not vector search/LLM)

results: Assistant source is propagated to the message
Product detail route products/:slug is registered
Top-k is capped at three products
Out-of-stock products are excluded from ranking
Add-to-cart verifies identity, SKU, stock, and price

manualCases.question: Yonex vợt dưới 1,5 triệu
manualCases.evidence: Brand, category, maximum price and in-stock filters are applied.

manualCases.question: Đánh đôi, cần vợt phản tạt dưới 1,5 triệu
manualCases.evidence: The prototype handles the racket and price terms but does not understand the playing-style intent.

manualCases.question: Yonex overgrip dưới 50 nghìn
manualCases.evidence: Brand/category/price filters leave matching in-stock accessories.

manualCases.question: Giày Yonex size 42 dưới 1,8 triệu
manualCases.evidence: Brand/category/price work; size is not used as a variant filter until the user selects a SKU.

manualCases.question: Aerosensa 30 còn hàng không?
manualCases.evidence: Out-of-stock items are excluded, but the prototype does not explain the exact unavailable SKU.

manualCases.question: So sánh Mavis 350 và Aerosensa 30
manualCases.evidence: The matcher can surface terms but has no dedicated comparison response.

manualCases.question: Mã sản phẩm không tồn tại XYZ-404
manualCases.evidence: There is no exact SKU/name confidence threshold, so zero-score candidates can still appear.

manualCases.question: Viết bài luận ngoài phạm vi mua sắm
manualCases.evidence: There is no out-of-scope intent detector in the prototype.

summary.browserNavigation: not run; requires a running API/catalog

limitations: The current advisor is explicitly a deterministic keyword matcher, not the planned MongoDB Atlas Vector Search/RAG retrieval path.
Hit@5 and Precision@5 require a labeled query set and a live retrieval endpoint; the report's prototype does not expose those metrics yet.
A browser-level click test should be run after the server can connect to MongoDB Atlas.
